versions.content: Specification of Vehicle - 2 - X Basic Transport AUTOSAR CP R20 - 11 19 of 37 Document ID 794 : AUTOSAR_SWS_V2XBasicTransport Name V2x Btp_ Tx Params Type Kind Structure Elements upper Protocol Type V2x _ Gn Upper Protocol Type Comment Specifies whether the BTP is interactive (BTP - A) or non - interactive (BTP - B). destination Port Type uint16 Comment Identifies the protocol entity at the ITS facilities layer at the destination of a BTP packet. transport Type Type V2x _ Gn Packet Transport Type Comment Packet transport type (Geo Unicast, Single Hop Broadcast, Topology Scoped Broadcast, Geo Broadcast, Geo Anycast). destination Address Type V2x _ Gn Address Type Comment Destination address for Geo Unicast. destination Area Type V2x _ Gn Destination Area Type Comment Destination area for Geo Broadcast/ Geo Anycast destination Type Type V2x _ Gn Destination Type Comment Select which destination type (destination Address or destination Area is used for this packet). sec Profile Type V2x _ Sec Profile Type Comment Security Profile Information (Determines the security service to invoke). max Packet Lifetime Type uint16 Comment Maximum tolerable time in [s] a Geo Networking packet can be buffered until it reaches its destination. traffic Class Id Type V2x _ Traffic Class Id Type Specification of Vehicle - 2 - X Basic Transport AUTOSAR CP R20 - 11 20 of 37 Document ID 794 : AUTOSAR_SWS_V2XBasicTransport Comment Traffic class id for the message. Description Structure containing BTP and Geo Networking related parameters that should be passed to the transmit request function (i.e. V2x Btp_ Transmit defined in 8.3.3) by the V2x Fac module. Available via V2x Btp.h
